question: Do isatty / TIOCGWINSZ / termios results reach the guest from the host, and are they identical across separate hermit invocations for a given configuration and across backends?

primary_anchor.why_this_binary: the only binary present on this box with BOTH --verify-strict AND third-party-backends (dbi+sabre) compiled in
primary_anchor.features: third-party-backends (dbi, sabre available; kvm present but does not complete this workload)

secondary_anchor.note: STALE relative to its own worktree HEAD 5562161a432e6eddca67f227abfbabc8380081a6; rejects --verify-strict. Used ONLY for the two cells the primary anchor cannot produce: the KVM backend (primary hangs) and the ttyname build-difference. 464cbd9f is an ancestor of 52d56e5c (verified with git merge-base --is-ancestor).

held_constant.COLUMNS: unset (removed so TIOCGWINSZ is the only width channel)
held_constant.guest_binaries: rebuilt once, unchanged across the sweep

guests.winsz-branch: winsz.c - reads TIOCGWINSZ and exits with ws_col % 200 (leak made guest-visible)
guests.winsz-silent: winsz.c - identical read, exits 0 (leak left unobserved: the blindness control)
guests.control: /bin/true - guest with no ioctl and no tty, used to show --verify-strict is red independently of this task

repetitions.main_matrix: 3 separate hermit invocations per cell (60 cells = 180 invocations), plus 1 --verify invocation per cell
repetitions.termios_axis: 1 invocation per (backend, host-termios) cell = 9 cells + 3 native controls
repetitions.note: n=3 is the double-run depth; this is NOT an L4 stress result

outputs.results.csv: 60 cells: guest x backend x tty-config; double-run verdict, DETLOG parity + message count, --verify rc, whether a log file was written
outputs.geometry-leak.csv: 15 (guest,backend) pairs: guest-visible observable at each of 3 pty geometries + verdict
outputs.backend-parity.csv: 40 rows: each non-ptrace backend vs the ptrace reference at a fixed configuration
outputs.termios-leak.csv: 12 rows: guest-visible termios per (backend, host termios setting) incl. native control
outputs.termios-sweep.out: raw output of termios-sweep.py incl. the ttyname single-terminal comparison
outputs.out/: per-invocation guest stdout (gitignored: regenerated by run-sweep.py)

gate_limitations.verify_strict_not_used: red on this box for /bin/true at log message 5 (a DEBUG reverie_ptrace::timer line embeds CpuId.initial_local_apic_id = which core the tracee landed on); taskset pinning does not fix it. No L2 claim is made anywhere in this experiment.
gate_limitations.dbi_no_log_file: the dbi backend writes no --log-file at all, so DETLOG parity is unavailable for it
gate_limitations.sabre_thin_log: sabre DETLOG message counts are 4-393 vs ptrace 120-2117 for the same cells, so a sabre 'parity holds' verdict is near-vacuous and is reported with its count
gate_limitations.kvm_absent_from_matrix: kvm does not complete this workload on the primary anchor (>120 s, killed); measured once on the secondary anchor only
